name: BFB price-defense burn of the pair's balance can be triggered by anyone with a zero-value transfer
summary: BFBToken._transfer runs _priceDeflPool on every transfer: when the BFB/WBNB pair's spot price is more than 5% below the recorded high it burns 5% of the pair's BFB and calls sync(), guarded only by from and to not being contracts, so a zero-amount transferFrom from the attacker's EOA to itself passes. With 407,488.84 flash-loaned WBNB plus WBNB borrowed against flash-loaned BTCB, the attacker bought 7.51m BFB for 494,415.85 WBNB (delivered to the Core address, the only allowed buyer), then 149 times sold a slice of its own 45,949 BFB and called transferFrom(EOA, EOA, 0) to burn another 5% of the pair's BFB; the sales returned 494,461.55 WBNB, 45.70 more than it paid. 25 seconds later it repeated the loop with the leftover 8,347 BFB for 350.62 WBNB.
notes: Anchor: the attacker's first run, 0xfc5af78c (block 108833134), 54 blocks before the transaction Verichains and DefiLlama cite (0xabcf5c5c, block 108833188, now the campaign). Over the token's history (PriceDeflPool events 0xb09821f4 from deployment to block 125000000) only these two transactions burn more than once; every other one is a single burn after an ordinary price drop. campaign.mjs --outflows on the pair's WBNB to block 126113134 ranks them first and second; no earlier transaction took more than 10.45 WBNB, and the pair held almost no WBNB after the second run.

Reset: deployment. The token is not a proxy; fallPriceRatio and fallPriceBurnRatio were never changed from their constructor values. The only owner writes before the exploit are setFeeToAddress (block 105526293) and setBurnRatio (blocks 105882283, 107646197), which only shape the hourly _deflPool burn split, not the price-defense burn.

Loss: the pair's WBNB depletion in both transactions (loss.mjs), 45.702428 + 350.616633 WBNB; DefiLlama's $197.8k counts only the second. The pair's BFB has no other market, so its burned and sold BFB is valued at the WBNB the attacker realised (rule 12).
